title: Amazing app
body: It was a really amazing and still it is amazing. I started using this app when I was fighting depression two years back. I start using it now to fight laziness and be motivated. To get going in the best way possible after having a trauma in life is not easy play but through this app I’m sure I’ll find my energy again and be productive. Sad part is that most of the good features have been included in the premium.
author: Muslim_girl47

title: Fraud
body:
My bank just called me and told me that a transaction of 20,000 PKR (~80 USD) was made towards fabulous app.
My app has been unsubscribed since 8th Feb, and I just chocked, it is still unsubscribed(non-premium).
So it’s obvious that this was a fraudulent transaction and misuse of my banking information.

UPDATE: fabulous contacted me and refunded less than half (i.e ~ 30 USD) the amount that was deducted fraudulently.
The full amount deducted fraudulently was nearly ~80 USD. 
This is not a resolution, sounds more like a pat on head :/
